name: notion-download-skill
description:
Download a spec-compliant Notion Skill as a complete tar.gz archive containing SKILL.md and its supporting files and nested folders. Pass the skill page ID. Returns a temporary signed url. Download and extract the archive to read or use the skill.

If availability is not already known for this connection, call get_tool_access with {} before using this tool. Reuse the returned access map across tools; check the status and restricted_parameters.

id.description: Identifier for a Notion skill page.
